relative_time: (frame-3)*0.05: last observed input is t=0; targets t=0.05..11.9 solver units
input_policy: Geometry, Re, coordinates and optionally last observed u/v/p plus two-frame difference. No later field or target-derived feature.
normalization: learned only from training-case future observations; input pressure centered independently within each known prefix frame
official_interpretation: Author DataPrep/fpo2d describes transient inputs as past flow states and outputs as strictly later states; old source has syntax defects and is archived as provenance, not executed.
correction: v2/v3 geometry+Re-only setup omitted known trajectory state. New input task is reported separately, not used to relabel old results. Poor v3 performance alone does not prove this is its sole cause.
representation: coordinate Fourier MLP + geometry/prefix CNN + local bicubic initial-state features; no learned Fourier convolution operator
hard_initial_condition: state-aware model equals last known input at t=0; control retains train-only soft IC supervision
bicubic_policy: polynomial interpolation differentiated through physical coordinates; jittered PDE points avoid spline-knot second-derivative seams
controlled_comparison: same width/depth/parameter count, seed, dataset, optimizer, losses, schedule, future targets, validation and 300k steps. Contrast conditioning + initial-condition formulation as a bundle; not isolated features-only ablation.
score: full fluid grid each of 238 future frames; per-frame Eu and gauge-aligned Ep; equal frame mean per scenario
baselines: persistence of last known prefix flow
checkpoint_selection: mean of sampled per-frame Eu/Ep equally across six validation cases
latency: full 1024x256 field; 3x200 warmed GPU timings both with exact cell-centre prefix features cached and with bicubic computed per query; context/host transfers separately. Prefix processing/rendering excluded.
smoke: same implementation executes both variants for 3 updates on one train/one validation case with PDE active before the main runs; smoke scores are not model-quality evidence
limitations: Data-assisted direct future-trajectory queries, not autoregressive rollout
Cropped domain lacks full external boundary histories; not a complete physics-only initial-boundary value solver
No LLM ranking, final test or statistical significance claim
